about: Resource meters of the house ledger (VERIFY_HARDENING 6.8, 6.11; WP1). For resource r the robot-attributable use is U_r = meter_r(F) - meter_r(idle at the same time) (without an idle rollout: meter_r(F) - meter_r(B)); the allowance A_r = max(floor_r, factor x the reference's largest U_r over the verification seeds (hardening.reference_resources), envelope.resources[r]); house.waste:<r> fires when U_r > A_r. path: the meter's state path (a dotted path; a missing meter reads 0).
